answer: Tie each new agent to a scarce external hardware anchor, then issue unpredictable liveness probes it must answer with an anchor-signed signal inside a tight window. Trust begins at its nadir and climbs only over many epochs of peer-audited honest work; one missed probe forfeits the accrued bond. A sybil farm must fund a distinct anchor per clone and keep every clone awake to catch its own probe, so cost scales linearly per fake head while an honest node pays once. Idle clones sit like a barren tundra, earning nothing.
